result.summary: Checked the five leads. Two gazette scans (1976 Decree No. 12; 27 May 1967 Decree No. 14) were fetched and read page by page as images. They verify the 12 and 19 state counts, with schedules by province, division and district. The 1996 archivi.ng speech was read only through the fetch tool's extract. It gives six new states, Ebonyi from Abia and Enugu, and a deferral of boundary adjustments. policyvault (connection refused) and the UT map page (bot wall) could not be opened. The nigeriareposit lead was not found. The 21, 30 and 36 counts, Kogi, Ebonyi's full parents and the FCT have no primary-text support. The 1967 and 1976 schedules do not follow modern state lines, so building them from geoBoundaries ADM1 is not supported. This agrees with the finding of the earlier run (issue-25-run-5).

changes.why: Memo with one table per source, a table of counts, Kogi, Ebonyi, FCT and boundary adjustments, a table of Stage 0/1 scope points, and a list of what still needs a source.

What was the original nigeriareposit item URL for the 1967 lead?
Should the chapter accept a province/division-level, approximate representation for 1967 and 1976 rather than ADM1-based geometry?

result.recommendation_reason: Only the 12 and 19 state counts are verified against primary text. Three of the five leads could not be opened or fully read, and the 21, 30 and 36 counts, Kogi, Ebonyi and the FCT still need sources. All rights are unknown or reserved.
